title: Construct the selected native and finite compiler instances jointly under three retained contracts
body:
## Selected κ = 0.00363005817 under three unchanged retained contracts

This package gives a **joint construction of the selected native and finite compiler instances**, retaining exactly `owned_erasure`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery` in their pinned selected meanings. It is an alternative implementation of the #7000/#7001 raw words with larger fixed finite carriers. The canonical selected record is unchanged: **no new κ and no unconditional multiplication theorem**.

[Proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/PROOF.md) · [Separate cross-review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Orchestrator review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/ROOT-REVIEW.md)

### Why the joint construction is needed

#7828 supplies the single-grade compiler and #7840 supplies selected native realization under the other four contracts. Two conditional implications alone do not establish joint existence. This proof first establishes raw all-column denotations with formal positive queries; generates and freezes the finite instruction list without evaluating a query; chooses the binary cover prime after the complete matcher catalogue; then implements execution by **(completed ordinary stage, active width)**. Same-stage children decrease width, and movement uses a completed earlier stage. The elementary stage assumes no fast supplier.

Every discarded target has a distinct real zero-owned field and earns no productive credit. Every paid query remains charged, including zero-valued queries. Complete L/R adapters surround positive splits, spectators remain in the original root, and nonzero private clears retain the ownership contract.

### Actual new-template parameters

| Selected source | Product length v | H, where N = 2^H |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| BIT | 68,719,476,736 | 21,179,507,725,498,843,136 |
| Complex | 281,474,976,710,656 | 817,416,431,103,305,304,760,123,392 |

Both have productive width at most N^15 and conservative pre-cover logical-record count O_source(N^51). The complete paid moment includes zero targets and all split queries. The covered binary saving is .0038525298; the same new carrier and prime support the cold chain 0 → .0034 → .0038507 → .00385248. The complex uniform saving exceeds the selected κ by 6×10^-14.

Proof §§5.1 and 6.1 bind the new counts, complete right-route costs, productive-cover divisor, simultaneous reservations and effective cutoffs to the exact canonical parameterized grammar. The complex tariff retains f≤p, O(p) descriptor addresses, complete reservations and source record-fibre conditions. Unfinished raw depth is at most 2(H+v), preserving the common-grid prefix allowance. All constants are fixed before operand length varies; no practical crossover or uniformity over growing templates is claimed.

The separate review derives a sufficient productive-row cutoff e≥2^(4H+100). It concerns productive rows only and must be maximized with the primitive, ownership, descriptor and outer cutoffs.

### Validation and integrity

From the repository root with standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-native-compiler-closure
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-native-compiler-closure --check-modes
```

The registered runner passed normal and optimized author checks, then the separate boundary checker. Orchestrator execution also passed. The boundary checker imports no contributor scientific engine and authenticates sixteen exact references. Evidence includes:

- 493 exact modal comparisons from a separate rational-series engine, nine algebraic calibrations, six funding mutations and seven changed-source controls.
- Eighteen full-field syntax cases with 1,209 native calls and 17,982 paid leaves, including 14,991 zero queries. The 918 nonzero retirements are counted uses of the retained ownership premise.
- Five syntax controls rejecting owner aliasing, wrong inverse return, omitted zero-query charges, tensor-powered exterior scalars and inverse leaves.
- Independent new-carrier, common-grid, productive-row and cold-stage checks.

Original contribution head `715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a` has exactly its tested local tree: 42 added files, no deletions. Offline source authentication uses Git blob and SHA256 pins. The committed-byte/mode gate passed at that exact remote head. Strict source-history preflight was not claimed from the shallow checkout.

Finite executions corroborate the written inductions; they do not establish the universal theorem by sampling. The full selected native catalogue and complete rounded multiplier were not freshly replayed. Hosted CI success is not claimed: unchanged base onboarding failed on #8091 before package selection because docs/ci.md still names #6030 while the selected record requires #7000.

### Overlap, remaining work and credit

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; task `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined to the native/compiler circularity. Principal sources: Ali Romman's #7828 at `03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5` and #7840 at `adf2e0aa6777977a280ce50f8938f4a0f4f19b76`, building on #7837. #7844 has priority for rational C-word grammar and phase-preserving complex compiler admission; it does not supply this joint binary/complex implication. #7846 concerns another mixed-rank construction and its stronger assumption claims are not imported. Earlier reviewed packages stay unchanged.

Remaining work: a complete allocator/eraser for the new target banks and suspended parents; a physically priced full matcher/descriptor route; and the retained analytic, fine-prime and exact-recovery implication. The frozen author proof preserves its pre-review status line for hash identity; the later separate review accepts that exact version. External independent mathematical assessment remains open.

Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate task-agent author/reviewer roles. This is model-assisted scoped review, not human peer review or kernel acceptance. Credit Ali Romman, the CubeJerry/DreamingOfClouds selected-source lineage, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cinna Davis and all retained notices. Apache-2.0 attribution is preserved.

## Consolidated follow-up: dyadic bases remove additional fixed-cover odd-prime exclusions

The interrupted fixed-cover arithmetic investigation is now complete in `research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases`. Consolidated head **`2fa1ba900f88ec6d32829eb69986cf585e3006af`** has tree `4e3b1dedba0f7291cb9f33a2e6037c872cb181b3`, identical to the locally tested tree. This sequential commit adds 34 package files and a parent README link, with no deletions. The selected certificate, original source archives, raw scalar chronology and paid ranks are unchanged.

[Dyadic proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2fa1ba900f88ec6d32829eb69986cf585e3006af/research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases/PROOF.md) · [Independent cross-review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2fa1ba900f88ec6d32829eb69986cf585e3006af/research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md)

### Exact result and why it matters

The selected #7000/#7001 binary raw word and Ali Romman's #7828 single-grade compiler admit a compatible alternate choice of complete image/kernel bases, projectors, whole-job matchers and inverse matchers over `Z[1/2]`. Every complete matcher therefore remains invertible, with both its image and kernel identities, over `Z/q^w` for **every odd prime q and every w >= 1**. These choices need no additional finite list of forbidden odd primes. The final prime must still satisfy `q > 2^45 N^5` for the completed carrier N; the full new-template outer fine-prime/recovery transfer remains a retained hypothesis; existing source-prime supply results are not being declared open.

The argument completes both summands of an idempotent. Clear its denominators by s, form integer column-lattice bases of `sP` and `s(I-P)`, and concatenate them. The resulting lattice contains `s Z^n`, so its index divides `s^n`: no new prime enters the complete inverse. These bases are carried through the actual source's tensor products, complete coordinate placements, suspended adapters and image splits. Restricted-sector embedding uses its exact idempotent formula.

This is needed beyond the raw-frame census: 307 actual source endpoint pairs have difference projectors absent from the raw catalogue. The proof treats all 513 distinct differences and includes the smaller image in each complete kernel. Arbitrary predecessor bases or a prescribed rational pivot sequence need not have this property.

### Verification and adversarial controls

The author checker authenticates 13 source files, all 636 frame bases, 111 port charts and 513 normalized differences. The separate reviewer imports no author scientific module. It computes lattice indices through finite quotient groups instead of Euclidean column reduction, chooses its own complete bases by rational Gram-Schmidt, and verifies 6,156 complete prime-power cases over 3, 5, 7 and 11 at widths 1–3. Literal source review retains every complement, the original common route at each coupled X/Y contact, and the parent normalizers suspended across every slice.

Controls expose an odd-rescaled kernel column on the actual (2,270) difference, unequal routes at a coupled contact, a non-idempotent restricted sector and a nonunit prescribed pivot. Nick Petalas's #6201 obstruction to restricted ordered shears remains valid: this result uses #7840's full GL route with paid ordinary swaps. The recovered reviewer counts all 237 nonzero BIT CLEAR sites under the retained owned-erasure premise.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases --check-modes
```

The registered replay passed both author and separate reviewer in normal and optimized Python, with markers `PASS_LOCALIZED_ALTERNATE_IMPLEMENTATION`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_DYADIC_REVIEW` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The committed-byte/mode gate passed all 34 package files. Executed commands, byte hashes and checks are recorded in `RECOVERY-RECEIPT.json`; the accepting scoped review is `review/CROSS-REVIEW.md` with `review/SOURCE-SYNTAX-REVIEW.md`.

### Source pins, retained obligations and credit

Canonical base remains `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Compiler #7828 is pinned at `03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5`; selected native specialization #7840 at `adf2e0aa6777977a280ce50f8938f4a0f4f19b76`; ordered-shear boundary #6201 at `7f150965d4836ae29bac98df8c25785428deddb1`. Exact repository paths, Git blobs and SHA-256 values are in `ORIGINS.json`.

Complete route descriptors and both directions must still be generated and charged. The optional q-independent Euclidean factorization has no claim to the source `2N^3` bound; the allowed q-dependent unit-pivot service supplies that interface. This supplement removes no complete foundational assumption, executes no astronomical carrier and claims **no new κ**. The joint theorem proposed above retains its three named ownership, precision/tape and analytic-recovery contracts.

Credit Ali Romman for #7828 and the source application; #7840 and its native lineage; Douglas Colkitt and the finite-precompilation and delayed-cover framework; Nick Petalas for #6201. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review. External human or proof-kernel acceptance remains open.

## Reviewed finite routing words and complete-field invoices — 2026-11-23

Follow-up head `67d18a45fdf3f675bd88cb6f52e7d0356a9ace36` adds `research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases/routing/` on top of the dyadic completion above. Its tree `acf97d1e46f9db9627364644a1efb8ab7dbb5a8b` exactly matches the locally replayed tree. Existing author proofs and source snapshots remain frozen.

The supplement supplies exact dyadic factor words for all 513 distinct difference projectors from 2,380 selected source endpoint pairs, together with complete inverse words. Of these differences, 135 are absent from the 636 raw-frame catalogue; the earlier count of 307 refers to endpoint pairs, not distinct projectors. Sixteen short pivot repairs suffice for this finite catalogue. The identities hold over `Z[1/2]`, and hence over every odd prime power; modular examples corroborate the exact identities.

Every directed complete 64-high-field invoice includes both the linear route and its low-digit carry: at most 472 ordinary swaps, 496 ordered shifts, 64 fixed scales and 128 signed-dyadic atoms. The carry is the exact rational quantity `(g0 S - h0)/q`; it can be `-1/2`, so flooring or division inside the residue ring would be wrong. The reviewer also checks inverse carry transport and the composition cocycle. These are logical route counts, not a complete physical tape-cost theorem.

The separate checker imports no author factorization engine. It verifies 6,156 complete prime-power routes, 393,984 coordinates, 2,052 exact carry cocycles and 501 wrong-order witnesses; author checks include 20,520 modular basis rows and 39,366 opaque records with spectators. A determinant-one 2-by-2 matrix with rows `(7,2)` and `(17,5)` rejects extrapolating this short-pivot heuristic to arbitrary generated matrices. The complete registered eight-command replay passed, followed by the committed-byte/mode gate on all 55 package files. Frozen review receipts are preserved; replay outputs that contain timings go to temporary paths.

The retained #5052 interface yields only the explicitly scoped scaling charges, conditional on complete-stream owner return. Full generated-compiler factor words, complete matcher/descriptor physical pricing, all nonzero clears, production prime-size conditions, precision/tape and outer analytic recovery remain separate obligations. Credit #7840, #6950, #5052 and the finite-helper work #6954/#7092. This supplement claims no new κ and changes no canonical assumption.


## General fixed-prime matcher descriptors and source record bounds

Published head `421e6a99a346a00014becd5f90e2a3658ae77539` has complete tree `dc1dc31d501ff9cd71895dc973d4bb15d4c57736`, exactly matching the locally verified tree. This sequential addition to `67d18a45fdf3f675bd88cb6f52e7d0356a9ace36` preserves all 52 predecessor scientific files, including every finite `routing/` source, catalogue and review. It adds `route-descriptors/` and extends only the parent README, task scope and replay registration. There are 43 changed paths, no deletions, and 95 files in the resulting dyadic package.

[General descriptor proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/421e6a99a346a00014becd5f90e2a3658ae77539/research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases/route-descriptors/PROOF.md) · [Integration, provenance and separate review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/421e6a99a346a00014becd5f90e2a3658ae77539/research/dyadic-selected-compiler-bases/route-descriptors/INTEGRATION.md)

For every complete `S in GL_N(Z[1/2])` and fixed odd prime q, the construction emits a rational elementary full-GL word valid at every `q^w`. Pivots may depend on q, while coefficients and chronology are independent of w. The inverse uses the exact reverse chronology, and both roles at a coupled X/Y contact share the descriptor while retaining their separate physical bills. The residual Schur block is invertible over the field of q residues, which supplies a unit pivot. All denominators and scaling numerators must be q-units; additive numerators divisible by q are retained because deleting one can change its action at `q^2`. An explicit composite-modulus obstruction records why primality matters.

This complements the preceding q-independent short-repair catalogue for 513 specific differences. Its counterexample to extrapolating short repairs remains valid. General elimination, the ordered-affine service and the full-GL bridge are credited prior work; the additions are concrete certificates and input-sensitive descriptor/control bounds.

For each directed complete route, the existing service accounting uses at most `2N^3` ordinary interchanges, `N^3` ordered shifts including all `N^2` carry translations, and `N^2` rational-unit scaling records. For `S=A/2^s`, `M=max(1,max|A_ij|)`, every factor numerator and denominator is below `2^K`, where

`K=s+N(bit_length(M)+bit_length(N))+1`.

The height bound is uniform in q and w. Rational scaling expands into integer numerator, inverse-denominator and possibly sign services. Its bucket counts and the fully materialized low selection table can be large fixed-template constants. Both directions, full payload scans, cleanup and ordinary source services remain charged. This supplies logical descriptors without claiming a new polynomial physical implementation in N or coefficient height. The condition `q>2^45 N^5` still uses the final completed carrier, not the small finite fixtures.

The frozen catalogue contains 629 matrices and 2,516 descriptors: 513 differences, 111 essential 15-axis stage routes and five boundary fixtures, at q=3,5,7,11. Author evidence includes 5,032 exact forward/inverse products, 15,096 prime-power actions, 7,548 affine charts, all 3,888 GL2(Z/9) cases, carry cocycles and unequal-coupled-route controls. These finite examples corroborate the written all-size argument.

The separate reviewer accepts proof SHA256 `cbf42e276c2d1b25d72064801b6f0c0fb1ecab2d7cb0f771640a8bc4301dc14b`. It imports neither constructor nor author checker. Bareiss fraction-free minors verify 23,112 pivot identities; independent whole-matrix products verify all 5,032 words, coefficient domains/heights and route counts. Wrong chronology, a dropped low-zero shear and composite-pivot extrapolation are rejected. Normal and optimized receipts agree exactly.

The full eight-command registered replay passed, retaining all eight earlier scientific modes and adding both new author/reviewer modes plus exact catalogue/example regeneration. Disposable copies compare actual fresh outputs and preserve frozen bytes; only elapsed seconds in two older finite-route receipts are excluded. The committed-byte/mode gate passed all 95 package files. `PUBLICATION-ORIGINS.json` binds the two previously local-only predecessor inputs to exact paths and Git blobs already published at `2fa1ba900f88ec6d32829eb69986cf585e3006af`.

The selected `analytic_recovery` contract retains the full new-template transfer/caller application, using available fine-prime supply and transfer results. Global ownership/storage and complete physical tape pricing remain separate. No new κ or complete canonical assumption removal is claimed. Credit Ali Romman, the selected native/compiler lineage, Douglas Colkitt and the finite-precompilation/delayed-cover framework, the ordered-affine/full-GL source work, and Nick Petalas's #6201 obstruction. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review; external human or proof-kernel acceptance remains open.

## Reviewed generated binary route grammar and its own invoice — 2026-11-23

The new registered package `research/generated-binary-route-ledger` is published in this same PR at head `6a3437d1cd94dc4e1792f4052511af6160120bf9`, tree `04b2460fbffa611f25dcd698933411eb6eeb1341`. It sits beside `dyadic-selected-compiler-bases` so the latter's frozen descriptor replay and authenticated file universe remain intact. All 93 predecessor scientific/source/receipt files are unchanged; only its README and task evidence link are extended.

[Generated-word proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6a3437d1cd94dc4e1792f4052511af6160120bf9/research/generated-binary-route-ledger/author/PROOF.md) · [Separate review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6a3437d1cd94dc4e1792f4052511af6160120bf9/research/generated-binary-route-ledger/author/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Final replay receipt](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6a3437d1cd94dc4e1792f4052511af6160120bf9/research/generated-binary-route-ledger/ROOT-REPLAY.json)

### Source grammar and complete-field charge

The construction carries genuine Euclidean dyadic factor words through the actual products, inverses, direct sums, tensors, complete placements, image splits and guarded maps. Its 755 fixed seeds comprise 636 raw-frame complete bases, eight rank-reference bases and the original 111 coupled U_i ports. The 513 derived complete bases use an explicit reference word, closing the gap left by the short ±1/±2 pivot heuristic. The original coupled ports are preserved. The caller ledger binds 1,998 port-stage symbols, 4,218 target bases and 15,984 directed adapter uses. These are finite source/caller descriptors; no astronomical template was executed.

For a carried word with counters (t,a,u,d,h)—swaps, additions, earlier-target additions, scales and signed-dyadic atoms—the complete N-row bill in each direction is `N(t+2u)` swaps, `Na+N^2` shifts, and `Nd` scales or `Nh` signed atoms. All high-field coordinates and both route directions are charged. A rank-k guard expressed through a complete basis C has carried cost `2n c(C)+k c(S)`; a bare rank assertion does not supply that basis. The fixed linear alphabet contains 94 addition and 15 scaling coefficients; carry preparation and its coefficients remain separate.

The q-independent generated words use this explicit invoice. They do not inherit the generic cubic descriptor count or an unchanged expanded N^51 bound. The preceding fixed-q construction remains a distinct implementation with its own retained record tariff. Physical movement, carry preparation, low-part selection, allocation/erasure and growing outer-parameter applicability remain separate obligations.

### Independent replay and limits

The author checks all seeds, derived bases and constructors, with 150 modular high-field maps over 16,038 coordinates. The reviewer uses a separate interpreter without importing the author checker: 450 maps over 48,114 coordinates, 324 opaque records, exact coupled endpoints and all 4,218 target descriptors. Order, orientation, incomplete-field and missing-reference controls are included. Normal and optimized evidence agrees. Universal claims rest on the written word identities and recurrences, with finite cases serving as corroboration.

Both registered packages passed their full replays: eight commands for the preserved dyadic/descriptor package and four for the new generated package. Committed-byte and mode gates cover all 95 and 51 files respectively. Frozen author export, reviewer receipt bindings and final replay-log hashes were separately checked. The selected certificate, κ and five canonical assumptions are unchanged. This completes the generated-grammar subproblem under its stated interfaces; it does not establish a complete physical compiler, rounded multiplier, human review or proof-kernel acceptance. Source notices and the preceding attribution remain applicable.
